contentList.content: Still, we need not begin with the fare thee wells just yet. We have tonight.
Life as the Vampire Ascendant is busier than I expected. There's my lair to decorate, spawn to recruit, a domain to protect. I'm exhausted.
You can snuggle up in my lap later, if you like.
Astral Arcanist
I'm not sure. Are you feeling especially weak?
Standing E
Your works ripple through the Weave. You've already left a mark on the city.
I'd expect nothing less from someone of your talents.
But we can't complain too much - we both survived, after all. Despite the odds.
Uncultured! Swine-like! Atrocious, all told!
This pass - signed by Gortash himself and scented like vanilla and rosewood - will get you into the Coronation ceremony.
Tiamat
Hmm. I think I needed that more than I realised.
'Absolute'? That's a little obvious, Jaheira.
This longsword never dulls, although an observer may notice it quietly drinks the blood of slain enemies.
*The city was the battleground for a fight that decided the fate of Faerûn, and you and Wyll were on the frontline.*
Well, shit. That's a bit of bad luck. Not my first, not my last.
You've done a lot of killing for a warlock without his powers.
Revel in it, Wyll. Let it wash over you - carry you away, even. It's a lot more fun.
A fair assessment. Faerûn has proved tolerable.
So maybe we find a party of pit fiends or a hundred chain devils waiting for us. We'll slice them into chunks like all the others.
And if they find themselves on the wrong end of someone's fangs, that's on them.
*Only six months have passed since the defeat of the Absolute, but Baldur's Gate is already recovering.*
Mmm-hmm, isn't that how it always starts?
And how are you feeding all your blood-thirsty friends?
But none of those legends I imagined were as spectacular as the ones we're writing for ourselves.
Bone Torch
Can I play along with you?
It sounds like you're faring well without your infernal powers.
Aha! You see, Boo? I told you our friend was near!
I miss you so much, Wyll.
Still, there's no friction that can't be greased with a sly promise or a proposition.
Nothing stands out, honestly. It's all been a flurry.
It's over. From dust Bhaal made them, and to dust they return.
The city's changed a lot under your leadership.
*Your cloister is strong, your faith is stronger, but you have barely slept since the Netherbrain fell, half a year ago.*
We've done so much for Baldur's Gate and its people these past months. I think we're entitled to a night off.
Bhaal's sent a heavy hitter. Slay the ghost first - he's the one provoking the others.
Upload Failed
And here you are, in all your robes and finery.
Camera Tilt Right
*He did miss this.*
Sketch Bubble A
They are making up for lost time, living the best life they can.
Reaching
It's nice to hear it.
Ptarian Pacifism
Oh, what I wouldn't give to snuggle up on his lap one more time. Just once would do.
I suggest we steer clear of the Trades Ward during Waukeentide, in that case.
Nothing, please carry on as you were.
That can't have been easy. Glad you've stayed upright, anyway.
What has become of the egg, Lae'zel? Has it hatched?
You know what? I'll just leave you to play.
Log Out
Dear Karlach. I thought slicing through the wings of a pit fiend would be the pinnacle of my month.
Shocking Brew
Wyll seems to be having a good time. We should enjoy ourselves, too, before your heart heats up and we need to head back.
It's been tough, but at least I'm there with Karlach.
You look, erm... Well the main thing is, you're alive. Plenty to be grateful for, horns or no horns.
Natural 20 B
I was nothing. A drifting dust mote of a wizard, abandoned by my goddess, my powers lost, my reputation destroyed. And look at me now. I'm their proof.
Well that's... half-reassuring. Good thing we've plenty of wild game around.
Disabled
*You measure time in aeons and eternities, and space is a matter of infinities, overlapping impossibly in the dreams of the divine.*
Oh Boo, do you know what it would mean - to find a cure for Karlach's heart?
Something nostalgic and gentle would be ideal.
Now I'm cured, I'm just like any old Baldurian. Nothing special, and glad of it.
Please don't poison any of our friends, Minthara.
A bold decision to treat a divine being with such cold indifference.
Bear man? Hm. He is big, but not bigger than me. I like him. I go to him!
I've been enjoying life. Throwing parties, making connections, slowly amassing power...
You've done a lot of killing for a warlock without his powers.
My dear - do you mean to say the ravishing creature with the Orin mask I met just last night wasn't you?
Dammon survived so much already. This world can be so nasty.
Letter from Mayrina
It seems like you're living a good life. I'm glad for you, fangs.
Perhaps I shall take Minsc. A return to Rashemen might keep him out of trouble... in every place but Rashemen, at least.
We would have been able to claim just enough of each other's hearts in order for it to hurt. Better to indulge ourselves fully whenever fate allows, than to live in compromise...
I was powerless to stop her... but I wanted to.
No - that was no killing strike. Was this the Absolute's doing?
A welcome reprieve from the faraway missions and bargaining tables of the months past.
Dead Wastes
With all the animals you've adopted? You've plenty to talk about.
Recount some of your recent exploits, sparing no detail.
Yes. If I can spend the rest of my days without unleashing another Guiding Bolt I'll be happy.
Grading Intensity
A prayer or two would suffice. Is that so bad?
*He seems excited in a way you recognise. He wants you to throw the object he's dropped. But it isn't a ball... it's the Astral Prism.*
How dare you speak that way of Vlaakith's gift?
Surely.
... And tonight, of all nights, was made for indulgence.
See? Something for everybody.
Ducks are my favourite, but I thought they were particularly fitting in this case. They are migratory birds of course, travelling far and wide with the turn of the seasons.
I'll want to have a good long talk with her before we make an arrangement. Though if I'm being very selfish, I hope she'll say yes. I'm absolutely famished - and think of all those memories.
Now I'm cured, I'm just like any old Baldurian. Nothing special, and glad of it.
I'm well aware of your 'web', but Baldur's Gate is under my protection.
*Under your watch, no demon will harm the people of the Sword Coast, and no wardevil will set it aflame.*
Hexblade Warlock
But first, Lae'zel, I need your promise.
A great Warrior of the Comet walks among us! Well - a projection of them, at least.
I don't need your kind of proof. I serve the people of Faerûn, not my own ambition.
Agh... away, Shar. Back to the shadows with you
You tried to apply for a library card in Menzoberranzan, Gale. I don't think you'll surprise them one bit.
Do not mistake this benevolence for indulgence. My patience is gossamer thin.
GRAH!
The perks of divinity are beyond compare. I haven't regretted my choice for a moment.
Turned to Gold
It's good to see you again, soldier. I hope it won't be the last time.
Find the guide.
So long as you don't try to convert me - or worse.
Unsettled
Perhaps Astarion and I can give the lecture together.
Murders by 'Unholy Assassin' Continue
Laying it on rather thick, don't you think?
You're happy, then? You think you made the right choice?
Gale Dekarios - the bravest man I ever met.
You are right, of course. I am accustomed to dwelling on the past, even when it brought me nothing but unhappiness. You changed that, and gave me the most precious of memories.
*You think back on the cambion you slayed a tenday ago. It carried a map with directions and blueprints for Zariel's own, private forge.*
I've been enjoying life. Throwing parties, making connections. And watching my old friends, biding my time...
You must be proud of them.
Wyll. My Wyll.
Gortash Black List
Nothing could make me happier. Gods, what a treasure you are.
For now, I don't want the githzerai to fight for us - just with us, my love.
Paper Bubble Tail B
This save file uses mods that can't be loaded on this platform.
I've missed you, Gale. Or should I say... your holiness?
I'd be delighted to introduce you to my current cohort - as a guest lecturer, perhaps? I'm sure they'd have plenty of questions for you.
We share a palace, share power, live lives eternal in each other's arms. What more could anyone want?
You see? Now you're realising your true potential. You, and many more by the day.
I'm afraid since we last met, my corpse count remains a paltry zero. Unless you count the boars I've felled on ducal hunts.
You have made allies and friends. Remain in Faerûn.
Later, perhaps. I must go.
Valour Bard
I wish to serve the people of Baldur's Gate to the best of my abilities. This is my one and only ambition.
What do you mean gone?
Bolstering Overflow
You're lucky none of my followers are around to witness this. Come here...
Transmutation Wizard
Don't go getting any ideas about wandering off. Your children need you.
I'm not sure. I hardly know where I am.
I've played to prettier audiences of oozes.
Uh-oh. Better kick that ghost's red butt, before his magic spell kicks ours!
Hast thy thoughts been with brave Karlach often?
Wyll Ravengard, the Blade of Frontiers, and bane of evil backsides!
We never found Omeluum - but we have bigger illithids to worry about now. The Brain awaits.
I never expected this to be your life, Karlach. But I'm happy for you.
You walk a righteous path, Shadowheart. And I wager you don't shy from righteous battles.
It is wonderful. I'm glad I get to share this with you.
I accept Larian's <LSTag Type="Hyperlink" Info="ModdingToS">Modding Terms of Use</LSTag>.
The Blade of Avernus and his companion are on the hunt. No hellbeast is safe from his infernal powers.
Alive. But he'll need some time to recover.
You saved a village from a rabid dire troll and have the scars to prove it. They'll believe you.
Enrol with the Fists. It's honourable work.
Touchy, touchy. But hey, I spent a decade in Avernus surrounded by imps and devils. Winning you over will be child's play.
Tell Halsin of how you've roamed far and wide, now that you are free of Shar.
I do expect you to bow, actually. Do it.
I don't understand. I meant to knock him out, not kill him.
Who is this Thayan?
- but seeing you brings me more pleasure than gutting every last hellfiend of Avernus.
*Already you feel the orb straining against the confines of Elminster's spell. It will not hold forever. How will you spend the time that you have left?*
Aren't you enjoying seeing everyone again?
Minsc and Boo have been helping, of course! We guard the streets while Jaheira is occupied with Harperish matters.
Somewhat, but there are times I miss my mortal life.
Kuo-Toa Acolytes
And plenty of room for more, when they find their way to us.
You were, of course, indulging me in submitting to such a lesson. 'Teaching' you was hardly an effort at all. Not like my present cohort of apprentices.
I knew of godhood before you knew your first cantrip, wizard. I knew it all very intimately - I was favoured among the pantheon, even.
However, the Blackstaff insisted I couldn't teach every subject, nor could the simulacra of myself I offered to create for that purpose.
I've mostly been hiding, making sure Cazador can't find me.
Close Filters
What does the 'God of Ambition' offer to his followers?
Do not forget, young Ravengard, that I too am one of the saviours of Baldur's Gate. I stood with you when the city was on its knees.
You must be glad to have Baldur's Gate back as you found it, Duke.
Your presence will be tolerated in their company, if you do not interfere with their holy destiny.
Survivalist
Want to play fetch?
Now, you protest, but I'm certain I saw you lingering over a first edition of 'The Plane-Shifting Pit-Fiend.' A pity it was so flammable...
Who says you're the titular hero, hmm? Oh, I jest - probably. But believe you me, I couldn't have written a word without you.
Your decimation did not even leave a mark on it. And now, only a fragment of your soul remains... and it is mine.
A bit.
I'm getting fragrant flowers and a mysterious accent I can't quite place.
Mistake me not, there is still much to be done. Plans to make. Maps to be frowned over.
Interplanar Braids
While the leather is cheap and the silver is simply paint, this outfit is clearly loved and well looked after.
Pspspspsps.
*The Karsite Weave palpates within you - stirred by the very prospect.*
Until then, I'll leave you to your own devices. Infernal or otherwise.
Fly
Go, my friend. Be among our friends - there is much work yet to be done before this one is fit to join them.
Freedom?
That makes one of us. This was only ever your fight, Lae'zel - not mine.
Finding more adventure wherever I can. Without any tadpoles this time, thankfully.
Torrential Undeath
Aspect of Athkatla
Can I have another hug please?
They ask about you, of course. But I keep them a little too busy for stories.
Heart B
If only we could stay like that forever.
Spawn? I'm the Vampire Ascendant, and you will address me as such.
Sounds like you're coming to the Hells then, Gale. I can't wait.
I felt a little strange after our last kiss.
Exploring this strange world, finding your place in it, dismembering the odd assassin - I couldn't be more proud.
But at least you have risen to a greater challenge than slaying goblins and bugbears.
My heart is still yours. And so it will be, until time stops and the planes split to pieces.
She grants me her divine power, yes. At times I wonder if I am truly deserving of them.
I do not know, Boo - all of our friends look well. But perhaps Happy has an opinion on who is fairest?
You'd best not have any plans to follow in Gale's footsteps. One god at this gathering is quite enough.
*Six months from the fall of the Netherbrain, you were hosting a grand masquerade in the refurbished ballroom of Cazador's Palace.*
Only partly by choice - this is a fine refuge from Vlaakith's wrath.
I could say the same about you.
And you must spend your nights waiting for one of your many enemies to cut your throat.
Someone should write of your adventures. What better biographer can there be than you?
A taste I've missed. So very much.
Maybe you don't. But I'm not done with you yet.
Zhak vo'n'fynh duj.
Duke Stelmane's Murderer Still At Large
Ah, Minsc knows these rituals well! He had to give them up on meeting Boo - there is only so much hamster hair one man can swallow.
I thought you might crave a little peace and quiet, after all that happened.
Well it'd be cruel of me to deny you...
Keep those hands where Boo can see them - lest you become the finger-food.
And Mizora? Is she next on your kill list?
Decline Invite
It's no City of Splendours, but I've a very good reason for being there...
The Waterdhavian scholar Yusuf Taji has been developing a grid-theory for city planning... Are the Baldurians not aware?
As 'darling' as a living nightmare can be.
Ravengard Returned to Full Strength
Run from me when we land. We will meet again at the end of days, when I shall come for you.
I see my blood not as a curse, but a duty. I have been studying Bhaal, so I can fight him, if his cult ever strikes again.
Invite via Larian Account username.
The Zhentarim are peace-keepers in the city now, Minsc. You have to live with that.
I do not regret my choice, although I do miss your musk.
Elminster Emoji
Next
You're finding it hard to stay away from me. Perfectly understandable - divine essence has a rather magnetic quality where mortals are concerned.
Letter from Francesca
The Flaming Fist were in need of reform. Has there been any progress on that front?
I've taken a breather in Limbo with Lae'zel, after myriad battles in the Astral Plane.
Our blood to fill the great god's oceans! Our bones to build the temple in the deep!
Shadowheart's Circlet
Just don't tell Halsin that, or he'll want an invitation.
All right. I won't deny any willing arm for the cause. Even those who should know better.
I was hoping I'd see you here.
She was like a sister to me...
Greetings, saer. Your noble bearing brings a little class to my humble -
- seeing you brings me even more pleasure than taking a royal inquisitor's head.
View as Grid
Except for those many covetous glances you once threw at Boo.
No, no - this was your doing, wasn't it?
Ah. A kiss as sweet as the first you ever gave me.
It's good to see you again.
I cannot account for thee, adventurer... hero... friend. But I know your story endeth not here.
Sanctuary of Loss
It seems Gith's son has been lost to the shadows. Perhaps one day, he will step into the light.
I've taken a turn as an adventurer and hero.
Thou hast arrived. Some call you 'saviour'. Others, 'adventurer' - or 'adversary'.
Tyrannical Branding
Tsk'va. You faithless snake.
Don't worry - your books and my hearth will still be waiting for us when we get home.
All right - I'll catch up with you later. But don't get to any of the fun stuff without me - got it?
I thought 'honouring the worthy' was a fair price to pay for Withers to pull me out the Fugue Plane. Alas - one purgatory to another.
Postcard C
They haven't seen us in six months! Nobody will mind if we repeat ourselves.
Bane's Chosen primed the Fist for a war they weren't meant to win. He convinced them there was an assassin hiding in every shadow, that cruelty was the correct answer to crisis.

He's just a frightened little pup - he has no idea what he'll grow up to be. And maybe with me there to guide him... who knows what he'll become? It's amazing what can happen, with the right nurturing.
Then permit me to relay the truth, as far as I was witness to it.
Crate of Tomatoes
Is this the Absolute's hand at work?
You stepped through the dusty one's portal willingly enough, no? And without Minsc even there to toss you!
Know that I love her best.
Blood Splatter C
And I you.
Add friend via Larian Account username.
You might be on to something there... though the name might need work. Somehow it sounds rude, even though I know otherwise.
Oathbreaker Paladin
Do you think your readers will believe a mind flayer could be a hero?
Letter from Zevlor
Tell her you've been living a quiet existence, and you're very glad for it.
I cannot account for it. How delightful.
I confess, I've found life a little too quiet since our journey came to an end...
Let's make tonight count - the only regrets I want to hear about come morning should revolve around an excess of carousing and questionable dancing.
Better gods than you have tried.
A toad in the form of a necromancer. I can only hope he has had the decency to die since our last meeting.
Frequent exposure to blood and other visceral discharge over decades has imbued the leather bindings of this document with a ripe scent.
Show me your wares.
Nor are you the same person who fell for me. Time can be unkind to hearts in that sense, especially if you fear change.
I love you, Lae'zel. To know you is an honour and a pleasure.
Kiss him.
It's quite something, isn't it, to be in the presence of the divine.
Naturally. A fledgling god is of little use where my plans are concerned.
Pactbound Maul
Reach out to embrace her.
An alliance? Do you think the Gith might again unite under one sky?
Nothing stands out, honestly. It's all been a flurry.
The law is clear: the refugees must leave. I can evict them.

I knew you would. Perhaps, once the manuscript is finished, you'd even be willing to write a foreword. Or better yet! I'll write a draft, and you can just sign your name. Better still, I'll sign it for you.
There you are! A bit less corporeal than I imagined, but looking splendid all the same!
Bronze Ingot
What does it matter? You're a mind flayer. This world is yours.
Braced Gate
And that, my love, is the day we can finally be together.
Tombstone
I've been staying alive in Avernus - barely. Hoping for a cure for this heart soon, though.
Father, I love you. I'm a good girl. A good good girl.
My Lady demands a lot, but some things are mine.
You helped Mr Dekarios save Baldur's Gate from the Absolute, isn't that right?
Hang on. I need to get this out before we can even think about picking up where we left off.
I don't want to talk about it.
I've known wizards of Lorroakan's ilk. So sure of ignorance in everyone else, they can't fathom being fooled themselves.
Blood Lust Frame
Ugh. I thought the beard was bad before, and now it's glowing.
What? Flirt with your Harpers another time. We're here on business.
Heh. I was as surprised as anyone when Orpheus spoke the order, my love.
Monk
Longsword
Xan will be a fine warrior, if he chooses. Or a poet, or an explorer, or a scholar.
Are you mad? The githzerai betrayed Mother Gith! They should be destroyed, not bargained with.
Was that a bear joke...?
Fear not - that tingling sensation is merely your body's way of alerting you to my presence. It's perfectly harmless. In small doses.
I've got myself a quiet little cottage, a growing menagerie of animals, and my parents close at hand. I wouldn't trade it for anything.
There you are! A bit less corporeal than I imagined, but looking splendid all the same!
We found an apothecary's ledger. It mentions a cellar we've already visited, and that it should be kept 'away from prying eyes'. Sounds like there's more to this cellar than we thought.
*Six months from the fall of the Netherbrain, you and Astarion were hosting a grand masquerade in the refurbished ballroom of Cazador's Palace.*
Prison Tatters
I was hoping you might have room for an extra lodger - rather large, feathered, well-mannered, mostly...
Spirit's still rattling around in there somewhere. Not sure it'll last, though - if I will.
See how they kneel to us? We are their protectors, their salvation, and we will rule them, together.
You did well to steer us from violence. But Lorroakan is too bloody-minded to be fooled for long.
Mizora's note of farewell. It smells faintly of sulphur.
I will join you both, and we will slay the traitorous lich queen.
Running
The ground shook as it charged me. I vaulted over the beast and grabbed it by the tail. It bucked and bellowed as I climbed its plates and straddled its head.
*Neither Selûne nor Shar will claim her in the end. Bhaal wants her more than those graven gods.*
Taste my lips. They are already laced with toxins - none shall be spared tonight, not even you.
I might have said we'd take care of the owlbear...
You have found affection and more on this rock. Stay, and pursue a new life.
I still feel like myself. My memories, my feelings - all intact.
I've taken a breather in Limbo, after myriad battles in the Astral Plane.

Salutations!

I'm writing to request your help in a mysterious case that has arisen since our little Bhaalian bash a half-year ago. Regrettably, I've had to take the credit for dispelling the Bhaal cult (in your absence, you understand), and am working on routing the remaining Bhaalists from our fair city. This has made me a target. A false document bringing my name into ill-repute has been made public - an alleged unpaid bar tab at the Elfsong. If you happen to be passing through with a bindle of coin, perhaps you can persuade management of my obvious innocence? Much obliged.

Investigator Valeria - Sleuth of Helm.

PS. I wrangled Devella a posthumous promotion to Blaze Fountainhead - she deserved that at least.
*Since the Netherbrain fell, you and Shadowheart have seen more of Faerûn than you ever thought possible.*
I hope Lord Gortash is deserving of his new title.
Are you worried about losing control of thousands of vampire spawn?
No matter how far away I may be, the Gate will always be first in my heart.
Florrick is Grand Duke of the Crossing, The Face of Devotion.
How have you fared since we last met?
No, no - I can see it all over that wet face. You've not a clue who I am.
Generic Voice 7 Male
All right - I'll catch up with you later. But don't get to any of the fun stuff without me - got it?
Never you, Lae'zel. That is all you need to know.
So, who am I looking at? Gale the teacher? Gale the hero? Gale the lover?
I'm not sure I even want to know what you've been up to.
The chance to see life through your good eye, as well as my own - it's been everything I hoped it would be.
This is an incubus. It will steal your soul. You may need it later.
We told Allandra that the 'beast' and its master have fled the city.
Wait - why are you here? I don't recall seeing your name on the invite...
Sacrifice.
And yet deserve so much more.
Here and now - that is enough for tonight, no?
Laying it on rather thick, don't you think?
*Your brain beyond brains calculates precisely how many creatures await death below. Ninety-seven thousand, six hundred and two.*
I spend most of my time trying to convince them how much fun the study of magic can be, but it'd be easier to crack a smile on an intellect devourer than some of my pupils...
If it means a chance to know you even better, I'm all in.
